label: No component is the first being, from esse-cause priority
description: noComponentFirstOfWeak with efficient-cause priority replaced by distinct-esse-cause priority. A component supposed first is in potency in some respect or participated. If in potency, act priority at a first being gives a being in act in that respect simply prior to it, which firstness makes the component itself, against non-overlap. If participated, it has a distinct cause of its esse (STMT-PARTICIPATED-ESSE-HAS-DISTINCT-CAUSE, the q.44 a.1 reading in the cause-of-perfection vocabulary), which is simply prior to it, against firstness. One cause-of-perfection relation at esse (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3) runs through the participation and priority premises; no passage to efficient causing occurs. That avoidance holds only because STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND, upstream of the esse-cause priority premise, covers every CausesIn … esse instance: if perfection-causing includes non-efficient exemplar or final causes, that bridge inherits the efficient-cause bridge's failure condition in stronger form. It uses the cause-of-being participation statement rather than STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE, whose type has the same body but whose record links the external efficient esse-cause sense (recorded sense-link defect, modal-spine note); that existing record is not changed. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
